labels.name: Primary Text
labels.gloss: A passage from a source, quoted or closely paraphrased, with its provenance given.

labels.name: Historical Doctrine
labels.gloss: What a tradition, school, or author taught — stated as theirs, not as ours.

labels.name: Scientific Finding
labels.gloss: A result of measurement or experiment, with the limits of what it establishes.

labels.name: Phenomenological Report
labels.gloss: Experience described as experienced, before any claim about its cause.

labels.name: Architecture of Hidden Forces Doctrine
labels.gloss: A position the system itself holds and is prepared to defend.

labels.name: Comparative Interpretation
labels.gloss: A reading that sets two or more sources beside each other and says what the comparison shows.

labels.name: Speculative Synthesis
labels.gloss: A proposal that goes past the evidence, marked so it can be tested rather than believed.

movement.gloss: Where light is what it is before it is given.
The giving — light leaving the source without leaving it poorer.
What it crosses, and what the crossing costs.
The boundary at which difference becomes quality.
Light held in a form, at the form’s measure.
A receiver of the same nature as what it receives.
What light does to what holds it, and what holding does to the light.
The seer, not the light, turned back toward the source.

tools.d: Select qualities — stable, golden, diffuse, pulsing, visionary, warm, shadowed — and receive comparative historical references.
Explore light by ontological level, purity, coherence, stability, medium, and operation.
Egyptian, Platonic, Hermetic, Indian, Buddhist, Christian, and other teachings set side by side.
Follow inner sun, captured light, luminous mind, or divine ray through history.
Key passages with commentary and links to related doctrines.
Spirit, soul, astral field, etheric body, organism, and material environment, moved through in order.
Halo, solar disc, lamp, prism, star, lightning bolt, black sun — each with its meanings.
